columns.purpose: Unique record ID supplied by the List
Employee name; create this separately from the built-in Title column
Team or branch; plain text keeps this teaching example simple
Degrees; newline-delimited in the canonical dataset
Technical skills; newline-delimited in the canonical dataset
Areas of expertise; newline-delimited in the canonical dataset
Software and tools; newline-delimited in the canonical dataset
Certifications; newline-delimited in the canonical dataset
Topics a coworker can ask about; newline-delimited in the canonical dataset
Self-contained local data-SVG image data URL; bind the stored text directly to a Power Apps Image property

systemColumn.purpose: Built-in document Title; leave optional and unused. It is not part of the canonical TeamMembers dataset.

notes: Configure the List columns before importing rows. A CSV does not create or prove SharePoint column types.
ID is autogenerated by a live List. The IDs in team-members.csv and team-members.json are stable local fixture identifiers only.
Every field except ID is a string in the canonical Team Explorer model. Multiline strings use the same newline characters as demos/teamData.ts.
The browser and download materials use this one canonical field shape: ID, Name, JobTitle, Team, Education, Skills, Expertise, Tools, Certifications, Location, Email, Bio, AskMeAbout, ProfileImage.
ProfileImage is plain multiline text, not a SharePoint Hyperlink or Image column. Each fictional value is a self-contained data:image/svg+xml data URL.
